title: Deliver Oil to Graninghead Oil Refinery
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Oil** delivered to **Graninghead Oil Refinery** (industry id 0, near tile 115,31).

A likely supplier is **Raningwell Oil Wells** (industry id 2, near tile 112,74); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
